info.name: Authentication Actions Crm Inbound V2 API
Load AWS Marketplace Authorization to WorkSpan

params.name: integration_id
params.description: Integration ID of CRM integration that is configured in WorkSpan App.

items.docs:
Load AWS marketplace authorization objects to WorkSpan. Creates or updates marketplace authorizations with flexible pricing and payment configurations.

REQUEST MODEL: AwsMarketplaceAuthorizationInboundRequest

NESTED MODELS (in data payload):
- pricing_terms (array) → Dimension model
- payment_schedules (array) → PaymentScheduleTerms model

FILE UPLOADS (form fields):
- customer_eula_file (optional): Customer EULA document
- reseller_eula_file (optional): Reseller EULA document

DATA FORMAT: Se
